SELECT c.id AS courseSpaceId,c.title,c.status FROM edu_course_space c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status!='ARCHIVED'
AND (c.owner_user_id=#{userId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_course_teacher team WHERE team.course_space_id=c.id AND team.user_id=#{userId} AND team.ended_at IS NULL AND ))
AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id=b.teaching_class_id JOIN edu_class_student st ON st.teaching_class_id=tc.id WHERE b.course_space_id=c.id AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND b.published_at<=NOW(3) AND tc.status='ACTIVE' AND )
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC,c.id DESC

SELECT tc.id AS classId,tc.name AS className,tc.term_id AS termId,b.id AS bindingId,b.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId ,COALESCE(ct.can_publish,0) AS canPublish,COALESCE(ct.can_grade,0) AS canGrade,GREATEST(COALESCE(ct.can_export,0),COALESCE((SELECT MAX(team.can_export) FROM edu_course_teacher team WHERE team.course_space_id=c.id AND team.user_id=#{userId} AND team.ended_at IS NULL AND ),0)) AS canExport,0 AS canPublish,0 AS canGrade,0 AS canExport FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id=b.teaching_class_id JOIN edu_course_space c ON c.id=b.course_space_id LEFT JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id=tc.id AND ct.user_id=#{userId} AND ct.valid_from<=NOW(3) AND (ct.valid_to IS NULL OR ct.valid_to>NOW(3))JOIN edu_class_student st ON st.teaching_class_id=tc.id WHERE b.course_space_id=#{courseId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND b.published_at<=NOW(3) AND tc.status='ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status!='ARCHIVED' AND ((c.owner_user_id=#{userId} AND ct.id IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_course_teacher team WHERE team.course_space_id=c.id AND team.user_id=#{userId} AND team.ended_at IS NULL AND ))AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND ORDER BY tc.id,b.id
